text: Ma Men jariba on nooneeji e musiibaaji; wano hulugol ayɓe mo'on, e heege sabu ŋakkireede ñaametee, e ɗoytagol jawle ɗen sabu waaseede ɗen maa saɗtugol heɗde ɗe, e ɗuytoral woŋkiiji ɗin sabu boneeji halkayɗi yimɓe ɓen, maa yanirgol shahiidi fii Allah, e ɗuytoral dimɗe leydi ndin, wewlin -an nulaaɗo- ɓen muññotooɓe ɗin musiibaaji sabu ko O Eltaniɓe aduna e laaxara.
